title: Fine-Tuning ASR Language Models for Underrepresented Low-Resource Languages
summary: UNHCR is fine-tuning Kurdish speech recognition for humanitarian interviews. Faster processing and more inclusive decisions remain intended benefits.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: UNHCR is fine-tuning Kurdish speech recognition for humanitarian interviews. Faster processing and more inclusive decisions remain intended benefits.
purpose: Make Kurdish-language humanitarian feedback easier to transcribe and analyze.
system: UNHCR Kurdish ASR and KoboToolbox integration
location: Intended coverage: Kurdish-speaking communities, including the Kurdistan Region of Iraq

ratings.reason: Humanitarian organizations are intended to process interviews and feedback more efficiently.
Kurdish-speaking people are intended to have their views captured more accurately; no changed service or decision is documented.
